note: Built from config.json of Moonholder/Wuwa_Mod_Fixer at each release tag. Blocks are the game version in which a hash pair first appears in that file (tag v2.2.0 is the first with this file, so everything older sits in 2.2 or earlier, pairs present in 2.2 are filed under 2.2). Pairs that were later removed upstream are left out. Pairs are cumulative: an old hash from 2.x maps straight to the newest hash, no chains. A hash can map to different new hashes for different characters (shared textures), so key by character and part. part "main" means the mesh hashes of a component (IB, position, texcoord, blend VB), "Diffuse/NormalMap/LightMap/MaterialMap component N" are textures. skip_components lists components the rendering fix must not touch.

rules.detail: Blend buffer vertex group remap. Run when the ini contains one of trigger_hash. WWMI blend buffers are stride 8 (4 x u8 index then 4 x u8 weight) or 16 (8 x u8 index then 8 x u8 weight): only the first stride/2 bytes of each vertex are indices and are rewritten through the map, weights stay. If component_remap is present the indices are local to a component: add that component vg_offset to both sides to get global indices (the number on the line containing vg_offset inside [TextureOverrideComponent<N>] of that component). When several remaps of one character apply, chain them from the first one whose trigger matches (compose old -> new through later steps). Also remap the BlendRemapForward buffer (blocks of 512 u16 entries) with the same map when the mod has one.

Derived texture hashes. A texture exists in several variants (name LOD = lower detail mip variants, Gacha, wet, injured, Charged, lvMIN or lvMax = quality levels). For each entry: if the ini has a TextureOverride with hash = <hash>, copy that section for every hash in copy_for that is not in the ini yet. Upstream only does this when the user switches on "stable texture" / "derived hashes" or the character is in settings.state_texture_removers (Aemeath, Camellya, Carlotta, Chisa). Ini text edit only.

Rendering pipeline fix (game 3.3). Texcoord buffer (vb1, stride 16): bytes 4 to 7 of each vertex are the COLOR1 vertex mask. Per component (found through the index buffer ranges of the ini, match_first_index and match_index_count; components in skip_components are left alone, default [5]) set bytes 4..7 to 0 when they are 255,255,255,255 (default), or, with the "Rendering 3.3" option on, when byte 4 or byte 6 is not 0. Binary rewrite of the texcoord .buf, backup first.

Stable textures (WW 3.x, RabbitFX). Replace hash-based texture overrides by RabbitFX texture slots so the mod survives later hash changes: handled by the upstream tool with --stable-texture (src-core/src/fixers/rabbit_fx.rs and resource_override.rs). The Woju fixer additionally removes CheckTextureOverride ps-t0..ps-t7 lines after injecting stable textures (from its GameBanana text). Needs RabbitFX in the XXMI WWMI package. Not re-derived here.

upstream.format: json (compiled from config.yml in the same folder)
upstream.notes: {"version":{min_required_version,current_version,..},"settings":{state_texture_removers,early_characters,enable_aero_rover_fix},"characters":{Name:{main_hashes:[{old:[..],new:".."}], textures:{newHash:{meta:{id,type D|N|L|M},replace:[old..],derive:{LOD:[..]}}}, rules:[{line_prefix,replacements:[{old:[..],new}]}], vg_remaps:[{trigger_hash,vertex_groups:"a:b,c:d",component_remap:[{component_index,indices:"a:b"}]}], stride_fix, shapekey_fix, hair_fix, materialmap_adapt, fallback_masks, skip_components, checksum}}}. The app can fetch this file as is and apply it; GitHub raw updates within minutes of a release. The tool itself fetches the same file (gitee mirror first) and refuses a config whose min_required_version is newer than the tool.
Release tags follow the game version (v3.7.0 = WW 3.7), so tag_name tells which game version the config has been updated for.
